name: Place the order
entry: The starting event: no record exists before L01
promise: proposed: none assumed by the code beyond one request: placing is a single call (L01), bounded only by the HTTP client's resilience defaults (eShop.ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs:22-29)
arrivals_per_period: not stated: measured by the operators

name: Accept the order
entry: Submitted: a park on the grace-period timer (lifecycle L03, L08)
exit: Paid (L06), or Cancelled (L05, L07, L08, L09, L10)
promise: proposed: 2 minutes from entering Submitted, read from the timing of L03, L04 and L06: a 1-minute grace period and up to 30 seconds to the next poll (OrderProcessor/appsettings.json:15-16; OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:17, 51), then 10 seconds before StockConfirmed and 10 before Paid (Ordering.API/Application/Commands/SetStockConfirmedOrderStatusCommandHandler.cs:22; Ordering.API/Application/Commands/SetPaidOrderStatusCommandHandler.cs:22). The stage is entered when the record is created, so a case's age in it is now minus "OrderDate" (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:58)
arrivals_per_period: not stated: measured by the operators

name: Ship the order
entry: Paid: after the irreversible L06, a park waiting on a person (L11, L12, L13)
promise: proposed: none assumed by the code: nothing schedules or times shipping (Ordering.API/Apis/OrdersApi.cs:12). The operators' dispatch target would set one
arrivals_per_period: not stated: measured by the operators

name: Deliver the order
entry: Shipped: after the irreversible L13, waiting on the carrier (L14)
exit: implicit: delivered to the customer (not recorded by the code)
promise: proposed: none assumed by the code; the carrier's delivery commitment would set one
arrivals_per_period: not stated: measured by the operators
source: lifecycle L14; reference-model check: SCOR 12.0's Deliver process covers providing finished goods to meet demand, typically including transportation and distribution management (secondary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supply_chain_operations_reference), work the code does not record; the code's last state is Shipped (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/OrderStatus.cs:12)
